faq.title: FAQ
faq.q1: Is posting a vehicle on AutoVerge free?
faq.a1: Yes. You can post your vehicle for free and reach buyers across Sri Lanka.
faq.a2: Add correct brand, model, year, mileage, price, fuel type, transmission, description, and clear photos.
faq.q3: Can I upload multiple vehicle images?
faq.a3: Yes. Uploading multiple clear images helps buyers trust your listing.
faq.q4: What happens after I post my vehicle?
faq.a4: Your vehicle will appear in the marketplace, and buyers can view its details.
faq.q5: Can I edit or delete my listing later?
faq.a5: Yes. You can manage your listings from the seller dashboard.

homeFaq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
homeFaq.q1: What is the AutoTrust Grading System in AutoVerge?
homeFaq.a1: AutoTrust is our vehicle evaluation system that rates cars based on condition, reliability, and trust factors to help buyers make safe decisions.
homeFaq.q2: How does the AI Price Estimation work?
homeFaq.a2: Our system analyzes market trends, vehicle condition, and historical data to suggest a fair price for both buyers and sellers.
homeFaq.q3: Can I search for a car using an image?
homeFaq.a3: Yes! AutoVerge allows image-based search where you can upload a car image and find similar vehicles instantly.
homeFaq.q4: Is AutoVerge safe to buy and sell vehicles?
homeFaq.a4: Yes, all listings go through moderation and verification processes to reduce scams and ensure trust.
homeFaq.q5: What tools are available for sellers?
homeFaq.a5: Sellers can list vehicles, track performance, manage ads, and get price suggestions using AI.
homeFaq.q6: What tools are available for buyers?
homeFaq.a6: Buyers can compare vehicles, estimate EMI, check AutoTrust grading, and use image-based search to find similar cars quickly.
